Technology SMEs should focus on developing B2B procurement portals, matching algorithms, and natural language processing interfaces to secure funding for scaling software solutions directly to federal entities.

The Department of National Defence has issued active solicitations for remote-controlled target carrier vehicles, closing September 3, 2026, alongside ongoing national freight forwarding and electrical services arrangements. Suppliers should align their operations with these existing procurement lists to ensure compliance with current federal supply chain requirements.
